I want to say "___ pen". The first sound of "pen" is "p". That is not a vowel sound, so I pick "a": I need a pen.
The rule: "an" comes before a vowel sound, and "a" before other sounds.
Right: He saw an owl. Wrong: He saw a owl.

Your turn. Write just one word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
